title: O Come to the Altar
lyrics_original: Are you hurting and broken within
Overwhelmed by the weight of your sin
Jesus is calling
Have you come to the end of yourself
Do you thirst for a drink from the well
Jesus is calling
O come to the altar
The Father's arms are open wide
Forgiveness was bought with
The precious blood of Jesus Christ
Leave behind your regrets and mistakes
Come today there's no reason to wait
Jesus is calling
Bring your sorrows and trade them for joy
From the ashes a new life is born
Jesus is calling
O come to the altar
The Father's arms are open wide
Forgiveness was bought with
The precious blood of Jesus Christ (2)
Oh what a Savior
Isn't He wonderful
Sing alleluia, Christ is risen
Bow down before Him
For He is Lord of all
Sing alleluia, Christ is risen (2)
O come to the altar
The Father's arms are open wide
Forgiveness was bought with
The precious blood of Jesus Christ (2)
Bear your cross as you wait for the crown
Tell the world of the treasure you've found
author_english: Wade Joye, Christopher Brown, Mack Brock, Steven Furtick

bible_verses.telugu: ప్రయాసపడి  భారము మోసికొనుచున్న సమస్త జను    లారా, నా యొద్దకు రండి; నేను మీకు విశ్రాంతి కలుగ జేతును.
bible_verses.english: Come to me, all you who are weary and burdened, and I will give you rest.

bible_verses.telugu: వాడింక దూర   ముగా ఉన్నప్పుడు తండ్రి వానిని చూచి కనికరపడి,   పరుగెత్తి వాని మెడమీదపడి ముద్దుపెట్టుకొనెను.
bible_verses.english: So he got up and went to his father. But while he was still a long way off, his father saw him and was filled with compassion for him; he ran to his son, threw his arms around him and kissed him.

bible_verses.telugu: నేనిచ్చు నీళ్లు త్రాగు వాడెప్పుడును దప్పిగొనడు; నేను వానికిచ్చు నీళ్లు నిత్యజీవమునకై వానిలో ఊరెడి నీటి బుగ్గగా ఉండునని ఆమెతో చెప్పెను.
bible_verses.english: but whoever drinks the water I give them will never thirst. Indeed, the water I give them will become in them a spring of water welling up to eternal life.

devotional.prayer_english: Heavenly Father, I come to You today tired of carrying my own weight and weary from my mistakes. Thank You that Your arms are already open wide to welcome me, not in judgment, but in loving mercy. I receive the precious grace bought by Jesus on the cross and ask You to refresh my thirsty soul. Teach me to daily lay my burdens at Your altar and rest in Your full forgiveness. In Jesus' name, Amen.
devotional.prayer_original: Heavenly Father, I come to You today tired of carrying my own weight and weary from my mistakes. Thank You that Your arms are already open wide to welcome me, not in judgment, but in loving mercy. I receive the precious grace bought by Jesus on the cross and ask You to refresh my thirsty soul. Teach me to daily lay my burdens at Your altar and rest in Your full forgiveness. In Jesus' name, Amen.
devotional.reflection_english: No matter how heavy your burdens or how weary your heart feels today, Jesus gently calls you to step into His presence. You do not need to fix yourself before coming to Him; He meets you right at the end of your own strength. At the altar of God's grace, the Father's arms are stretched wide to welcome you home, offering complete forgiveness and living water that truly satisfies. Lay down your weight and rest securely in His love.
